description: Put back what a PUT through sb_api_call replaced — settings, a product, a form, anything with a shape. IN THIS PROCESS ONLY, capped, and gone when it exits. For a PAGE the platform keeps its own: GET .../pages/{pageId}/history lists the autosave checkpoint it writes on every draft save, versions lists the labelled snapshots, and either restores. That one survives everything and is the better answer whenever the thing to recover is a page. No argument lists what is undoable here.
name: sb_undo
